_comment: One file per class. All classes share the studio05 base body; a class is an animation set plus how our moves map onto its clips. Add a class = add a file here, drop its clips next to the body, point 'animations' at them. 'weapon' is the combat weapon id in data/combat/weapons.json (its overrides hold the class's advance distances: advance = clip hip travel in metres * 7.2, see client/characters/studio05_character_model.gd).
_weapon_families: Weapon items (catalog weapon_type) this class card may wear in its weapon slot, logic/profile.gd card_can_wear (Boss 2026-11-11).
_idle_variants: Idle clips the card portraits (hub cards, character screen) cycle through: mostly states.idle, now and then another one (client/card_portrait.gd). Display only; battle fighters keep states.idle.
_hair_options: Studio 2026-11-11 index.html hair buttons A, B, C, E, F, G (offered for every class); G = hair/hair_g.glb. Each is a hair-only file (art/characters/studio05/split/manifest.json) merged onto the class body.
_signature: GDD races-and-classes 3.2 class signature, read by logic/race_passives.gd (any race). Bulwark: every 8 s, enemies within 5 m attack this card for 3 s (it pulses once an enemy is in range).
_pilot: GDD races-and-classes 3.2 pilot profile, read by logic/auto_pilot.gd for squad cards (a class without it keeps the old constants). target: nearest|peel|densest|lowest_hp|marked_first. engage_range 0 = from the weapon; shoot_range 0 = the default 6 m. prefer_marked: attack a target carrying mark_status inside the engage range first (Hunter's Mark focus fire). line is not used yet.
_gauge: GDD races-and-classes 3.10.2: this class's multipliers on the shared race gauge rule (data/races/rules.json gauge, formula 4.7), read by logic/race_passives.gd.
_skill_tree: Class branch of the card skill tree (design/gdd/skill-tree.md 3.1, 3.8): 16 nodes T1..T4, validated by logic/skill_tree_data.gd against data/skill_tree/rules.json. excl = OR pair id. Numbers are placeholders.

nodes.name: Tempest Step
nodes.text: Storm Blades also taunts: `pulse_aggro` r3 m, 2 s at the end of the dash. The tank's dash now pulls attention off the back line.

nodes.name: Iron Answer
nodes.text: Riposte `parry_window` 0.5 → 0.8 s. A successful counter gives self `fortify` 3 s.

nodes.name: Shared Blood
nodes.text: Blood Shield also shields the most-hurt ally for 50% of the amount.

nodes.name: Ward Line
nodes.text: Flame Dash trail duration 3 → 5 s. Enemies crossing it get `slow`.

nodes.name: Mending Shell
nodes.text: regen gem (2% max HP/s while it lasts, cooldown ×1.2).

nodes.name: Unyielding Bulwark
nodes.text: Bulwark cycle every 8 → 6 s. While a Bulwark taunt is up, the card takes −15% damage.

nodes.name: Rallying Wall
nodes.text: Each Bulwark pulse also gives `fortify` 3 s to allies within 4 m (`signature_pulse` trigger).

nodes.name: Spiked Bastion
nodes.text: While a Bulwark taunt is up, 25% of damage taken is reflected to the attacker (`reflect`). The tank becomes a damage source.

nodes.name: Immovable
nodes.text: `CONTROL_IMMUNE` (no stun, knockback or stagger) and Bulwark radius 5 → 8 m. The tank becomes a wall that never breaks.
